# HaikaiTech Solutions

HaikaiTech Solutions is a registered software engineering studio in Penang, Malaysia (SSM: 202603149868, CA0422517-K), run by Iffat Haikal. We build business websites, custom web apps, dashboards, and interactive systems for clients across Malaysia — most of our clients are based in Kuala Lumpur — and worldwide.

## What we do

### Business websites
Professional, mobile-responsive websites for Malaysian businesses. Two ways to work:
- **Website Siap (one-time)**: from RM1,500. Up to 5 pages, mobile responsive, WhatsApp integration, contact form, Google Maps, Google Search ready, Google Search Console setup, Google Analytics 4, basic SEO, SSL, and deployment. Annual renewal RM350/year covers domain, hosting, SSL, and basic technical maintenance. Content updates billed separately.
- **Business Website Plan (managed)**: RM199/month, 12-month minimum. Everything managed — professional website, hosting, domain (if required), SSL, website maintenance, security monitoring, regular backups, small content updates, and technical support. No large upfront payment.

### Company profile design
Professional company profile documents, RM800–RM1,200 depending on number of pages, content readiness, and design complexity. Usually bundled with a website (e.g., company profile + website from RM2,300 one-time, or company profile + monthly plan).

### Custom software & systems
Quotation-based work: custom web apps, business dashboards, .NET/Blazor systems, Unity visualizations, and integrations. Pricing depends on scope — chat on WhatsApp for a quote.

### Add-ons
- Additional page: RM150–250 per page
- Additional language (BM/EN): from RM500
- Blog/CMS: from RM500
- Copywriting: quotation
- Logo design: from RM300
- Google Business Profile setup: RM300
- Email setup: RM150
- Website migration: quotation

### Maintenance for one-time clients
- Minor update: RM50–100
- New section: RM100–200
- New page: RM150–250
- Major redesign: quotation

3. We build and deploy. You own the result.
